Source documents: alder-work-order-lines.csv, alder-commercial-terms.csv and alder-purchase-approval.json.
Use the purchase lines. Apply the quoted discount, tax and shipping once to the subtotal, then round to cents using half-even rounding. Return the transaction reference and a brief reconciliation summary.
